title: Fix pagination drift in billing
why: Page boundaries shift when rows are inserted mid-scroll; duplicates show up.
what: Switch src/billing/query.js from offset to keyset pagination on (created_at, id).

title: Document the the session store failure modes
why: On-call keeps rediscovering the same edge cases from scratch.
what: Write src/sessions/RUNBOOK.md covering the three known failure modes and their signals.

title: Tighten error messages in billing
why: Current errors leak internals and confuse support tickets.
what: Map internal errors to user-facing codes in src/billing/errors.js; log the detail, return the code.

title: Migrate the session store config to the shared loader
why: It still reads env vars ad hoc; every other module uses the typed loader.
what: Replace process.env reads in src/sessions/config.js with the shared loader and defaults.

title: Add integration tests for auth
why: Only unit coverage today; the seams between modules are where bugs land.
what: Cover the three main flows end to end in tests/auth.integration.test.js against a real store.

title: Instrument rate limiting with latency histograms
why: We only have averages today; p99 regressions go unnoticed.
what: Emit histogram buckets from src/ratelimit/middleware.js into the metrics pipeline.
notes: surfaced via post-commit discovery scan on commit dc884b4

title: Fix timezone handling in i18n
why: Dates render off-by-one for users west of UTC.
what: Store UTC in src/i18n/serialize.js and convert at the render edge only.
notes: surfaced via post-commit discovery scan on commit cbf7776

title: Add retry backoff to exports
why: Transient upstream failures currently bubble straight to users.
what: Wrap outbound calls in src/exports/client.js with exponential backoff — 3 attempts, 200ms base.
notes: surfaced via post-commit discovery scan on commit bde4018

title: Document the onboarding failure modes
why: On-call keeps rediscovering the same edge cases from scratch.
what: Write src/onboarding/RUNBOOK.md covering the three known failure modes and their signals.

title: Debounce duplicate events in notifications
why: Upstream sends bursts; we process the same event several times.
what: Key events by idempotency token in src/notifications/consumer.js; drop repeats inside a 60s window.
